_comment: DEMO trust store for the --trust-store minimal slice (ninth review, P10): COSE kid -> expected signer role, allowed identities (evidence: rdp_id; discovery: the entity uid the key may sign for), Ed25519 public key and validity window (LINT-TRUST-01..03, fail-closed). DEMO material only — a production trust store is QSealC / EU-Trusted-List material, which this format deliberately does NOT represent (see README, production verification roadmap). The keys are the published demo keys from the README.

federation-authority._comment: §13.1 gives the Federation Authority and the design authority DIFFERENT rows, so the demonstration gives them different keys. A membership record signed by the design-authority key is refused: a register whose admission decisions were signed by the protocol's own maintainer would demonstrate the opposite of the independence §13.1 requires.

mockeu-001-descriptor._comment: Batch A / A5: a provider descriptor (BW-PROVIDER-v1) is sealed by the PARTICIPANT, not by an entity's wallet-administration function, so its identity space is `participant_id` and not a UID. The same key is pinned to this participant in federation.stage1.demo.json (`authorized_seal_keys`), which is what LINT-TRUST-07 checks. DEMO key, seed 'mockeu-001-descriptor-demo'.
